name: Domna Salonen
methodsExpertise: facilitating conversations between people with different backgrounds and viewpoints
bio: Domna is a mental health occupational therapist and an early career researcher interested in complex psychosocial interventions. She is at home in interdisciplinary teams where everyone can learn from each other. Her research focuses on the interpersonal reality of mental health and wellbeing, e.g. family systems, everyday communications and routine care.
researchKeywords: Psychosocial care, human relationships, mental health and wellbeing, complex adaptive systems
